children: Singh moves from Kirloskar Oil Engines after more than three years, with a focus on people strategy and organisational capabilities
Amarjeet G Singh has taken on the role of Vice President – Human Resources and Corporate Affairs at Kirloskar Industries Ltd, marking a new leadership responsibility within the Kirloskar Group.
Singh announced the appointment in a LinkedIn post, describing the move as a transition within the group. He moves from Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited, where he spent more than three and a half years.

During his tenure at Kirloskar Oil Engines, Singh said he was involved in the organisation's growth journey, including its 2x3y programme and its evolution towards the 4x5y ambition. He highlighted his contributions to organisational building, people transformation and strengthening capabilities for the future.

Reflecting on his time at the company, Singh thanked the leadership team and his HR colleagues for their trust, support and collaboration.In his new role, Singh said he would focus on strengthening the people agenda, building organisational capabilities and contributing to the broader corporate affairs function at Kirloskar Industries.
His appointment brings his experience within the group to a wider corporate leadership role, with responsibilities spanning human resources and corporate affairs.
